Hi Alex / Samantha,

Thanks again for the kickoff today — great sync. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth: 

Summary / scope
- POC scope: validate Redwood inference for real-time personalization on product pages (recommendation scoring + short-form text generation for microcopy).
- Success criteria (customer-proposed): p50 latency <= 300ms for 95% of inference requests; stable throughput at 20 rps during traffic window; embedding similarity delta < 0.03 vs baseline for key queries; zero production data exfiltration.

Evaluation plan & timeline (proposed)
- Dec 20: POC environment provisioned (Redwood Dedicated trial) and datasets uploaded.
- Dec 21–Jan 5: Integration & evaluation (feature tests, run queries, collect metrics).
- Jan 6–Jan 10: Regression QA, final review, decision meeting week of Jan 12.

Owners
- Customer (data & product): Alex Johnson (Stellar) — dataset prep, acceptance tests.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole — overall AM; Dev Patel — infra + integration; Neha Kapoor — security/compliance signoff.

Immediate asks
1) Alex: confirm datasets & test queries by EOD Dec 18.
2) Redwood: provision Dedicated trial and share access by Dec 20.
3) Both: confirm acceptance test cases (I attached a starter eval plan).

I'm attaching the initial POC eval plan and a risk tracker spreadsheet where we'll capture blocking issues and mitigations. I'll keep the tracker updated and share weekly status.

Thanks — looking forward to momentum.

Best,
Marissa

Quick update from infra side after initial provisioning run this morning:

Status
- Dedicated trial provisioned in us-west1; endpoints are up. I shared access with Alex (email invite).
- Initial synthetic load test hitting ~22 rps at p50 ~260ms, p99 ~920ms (so p50 target looks good; p99 slightly above target).

Blocking issue found
- We observed cache warmup behavior causing a set of early requests to spike p99 above 1.2s for certain long-tail keys. Root cause: default KV cache throttle doesn't pre-warm on new workloads.
- Logged as ISSUE-001 in the tracker (attached error-log-20261218.txt). Severity: high (blocks acceptance if not mitigated).

Mitigations (short-term)
1) Conservative: add prefilling job to warm KV cache for the first 24 hours (works within current infra) — ETA 6 hours to implement and test.
2) Medium: tweak cache throttle to be more aggressive on first N minutes — needs 1 dev-day to test safe rollout.
3) Long-term: persistent cache snapshotting for faster restarts (needs product & infra planning).

Escalation path
- If ISSUE-001 isn't mitigated within 12 business hours, escalate to Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) and open a P0 pager. For customer transparency we'll message the customer with ETA and mitigation plan.

I'll implement the prefilling job now and update the tracker. Neha — please confirm whether the log retention settings we applied satisfy the 30d purge.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
